items.rationale: The model keeps nothing between calls; the program keeps the message list and sends it again each call. Choosing a shows the belief that the model remembers the conversation itself.
Inputs are 1,000, 3,000, 5,000, 7,000 and 9,000, which sum to 25,000. An answer of 9,000 counts only the last call, and 5,000 or 10,000 forget that every call resends the list.

A message list ends with the session, so what must survive is written to storage outside the window and read back later. A larger window or a single running list does not persist past the session, and fixed instructions cannot hold per-student facts.
